text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Doubts surrounded Katsuragi Ace's aptitude 
for long distances. Even so, there are 
certainly those who still anticipate the 
run of an "Ace."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace has inspired courage in 
everyone around her. Yet she didn't do it 
on her own strength alone. It was only 
possible with her Trainer's support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yes, her trump card—her "Ace"—was her 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rebel, Katsuragi Ace. She will show 
her valor at the Arima Kinen!
